line: e4 c6 d4 d5 Nc3 dxe4 Nxe4 Nf6 Nxf6+ exf6
teaches: When you recapture, taking toward the centre usually beats taking toward the edge, even at the cost of doubled pawns — doubled pawns that open a file for your pieces and build a wall in front of your king are a feature, not a flaw. Judge a pawn weakness by what it actually does, not by the name it carries.
explains: Capturing toward the centre doubles the f-pawns but opens the e-file that the rook will use once the king castles, and it leaves a solid block on f6, f7, g7 and h7 to shield the king. The structure looks damaged and is genuinely comfortable to play.
